The '''Vuultin Starburst''' was a garish medal designed by [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Lon Isoto]] to commemorate the [[181st Imperial Fighter Wing/Legends|181st Imperial Fighter Group's]] role in protecting [[Vuultin]] during the [[Battle of Brentaal IV (Galactic Civil War)|Battle of Brentaal IV]]. [[Major/Legends|Major]] [[Turr Phennir/Legends|Turr Phennir]] was the first and only recipient of the Starburst. It was also offered to [[Soontir Fel/Legends|Soontir Fel]] but he refused on the grounds of it being created by a coward and thus meaningless. After the admiral was killed, the award effectively ceased to exist.
